name: onlydns-mcp
description: Model Context Protocol server for OnlyDNS to manage DNS zones, records, DNSSEC, and TSIG keys.

api_token.title: OnlyDNS API Token
api_token.description: Your OnlyDNS API Bearer Token for managing DNS zones and records

api_base_url.title: API Base URL
api_base_url.description: Optional base URL override for the OnlyDNS API

tools.name: list_domains
tools.description: List all DNS domains in your OnlyDNS account

tools.name: create_domain
tools.description: Create a new DNS domain zone in OnlyDNS

tools.name: list_records
tools.description: Get all DNS records for a domain with optional name and type filters

tools.name: add_record
tools.description: Add a new DNS record to a domain

tools.name: update_record
tools.description: Update an existing DNS record in a domain

tools.name: delete_record
tools.description: Delete a DNS record from a domain

tools.name: set_records
tools.description: Bulk set or replace all DNS records for a domain

tools.name: get_dnssec
tools.description: Get DNSSEC status and DS/DNSKEY records for a domain

tools.name: enable_dnssec
tools.description: Enable DNSSEC signing for a domain

tools.name: disable_dnssec
tools.description: Disable DNSSEC signing for a domain

tools.name: list_tsig_keys
tools.description: List all TSIG keys in your OnlyDNS account

tools.name: create_tsig_key
tools.description: Create a new TSIG key for AXFR zone transfers

tools.name: delete_tsig_key
tools.description: Delete a TSIG key by name

tools.name: configure_domain_tsig
tools.description: Configure or attach TSIG keys to a domain for AXFR access

tools.name: remove_domain_tsig
tools.description: Remove all TSIG key configurations from a domain
